title: File:Gilead Truvada for HIV PrEP - Blue Pills (48610083847).jpg
art: Tony Webster from Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States
desc: Truvada for PrEP, an HIV antiretroviral drug taken by HIV-negative persons in at-risk communities like people in relationships with partners who are HIV-positive or have an unknown status, to prevent an HIV infection. Taken daily, it can be about 99% effective in combination with safe sex practices.

title: File:Gilead Sciences Descovy for HIV PrEP (49765063118).jpg
desc: A bottle of Descovy for PrEP (pre-exposure prophylaxis) from Gilead Sciences, a pharmaceutical company. Descovy is a combination of emtricitabine and tenofovir alafenamide and is used to prevent an HIV infection. Descovy is an alternative to Truvada.
